##: Agnes Code, the desktop AI workbench of Agnes AI (agnes-ai.com/agnescode).

The page's Windows button serves https://cos-agnes-code.agnes-ai.cn/release/latest/AgnesCode-Installer.exe, while the app's own electron-updater reads resources/app-update.yml (provider generic) and pulls AgnesCode-Setup.exe from the same latest/ prefix. Both files were opened: the payloads are identical (4693 entries, 1731880253 bytes, 3954 files), only the NSIS compression level differs, so the manifest pins Setup.exe because that is the file whose SHA-512 is published in latest.yml.

The object name carries no version and the COS bucket refuses listing, so the version comes from latest.yml. It is confirmed twice inside the payload: resources/agnes-build-manifest.json reports 1.1.5 and AgnesCode.exe carries ProductVersion 1.1.5.

The installer is electron-builder NSIS-3 Unicode (per-user, one-click): $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z holds the app flat, with AgnesCode.exe at the root, and $R0 only carries 'Uninstall AgnesCode.exe'. The installer script expands the payload into $dir and drops both folders.
Only x64 is published; the page offers macOS on Apple silicon and Intel but no Windows ARM or 32-bit build.
checkver reads latest.yml, which the vendor regenerates on every release and serves with 'Cache-Control: max-age=0'.

autoupdate.hash pulls the base64 sha512 out of latest.yml through the $base64 template; Scoop decodes it to hex, and the decoded value matches the local SHA-512 of Setup.exe. Because the feed only publishes SHA-512, an auto-updated manifest carries a 'sha512:' digest while this initial one keeps the usual SHA-256.
description: AI coding desktop client with local project spaces, skills and MCP app connections
notes: The NSIS stubs ($PLUGINSDIR and the bundled 'Uninstall AgnesCode.exe') are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
Settings, project indexes and chat history live under "$env:APPDATA\Agnes Code", and the updater cache under "$env:LOCALAPPDATA%\agnescode-updater", so nothing needs to be persisted.

The bundled electron-updater stays enabled. An in-app update runs the vendor installer, which creates a per-user copy outside the Scoop app directory instead of replacing it; run 'scoop install agnes-code -f' afterwards to return to the packaged build.
The download is 444 MiB and unpacks to about 1.7 GB, because resources\bin carries its own Node, uv and the agnesd daemon.
